title: Flow Cytometry Analysis of Human Islet Cell Expression of Heparan Sulfate and Collagen Type XVIII
author: Sarah Popp
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kwzcxf6

steps.title: Initial islet centrifugation and wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge human islets at 300 g for 2 min at 23 °C, pour off the supernatant, resuspend in approximately 25 ml PBS containing 3 mM EDTA, then centrifuge again at 300 g.

steps.title: Transfer to tubes and wash
steps.instruction: Resuspend the islets in PBS/3 mM EDTA, aliquot 2000 IEQ into each 15 ml tube, centrifuge at 300 g, and carefully remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Accutase digestion
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend each pellet in 1 ml pre‑thawed Accutase, place tubes in a 37 °C water bath for 10 min, tapping gently at 4 min and 8 min to aid resuspension.

steps.title: Mechanical dissociation
steps.instruction: Pipette the islet suspension up and down 10–15 times with a 1 ml single‑channel pipette to dissociate the cells.

steps.title: Terminate Accutase and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Add 10 ml culture medium to each tube to stop the Accutase reaction, then centrifuge for 5 min at 300 g.

steps.title: Pool cells and adjust density
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, pool all cells into a single 15 ml tube, determine cell density with a hemocytometer, and adjust to a concentration of 100 000–325 000 cells ml⁻¹.

steps.title: Plate cells
steps.instruction: Dispense 20 000–65 000 cells in 200 µl per well of a culture plate.

steps.title: Centrifuge plated cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plates at 300 g for 3 min at 23 °C and remove the supernatant by flicking.

steps.title: Intracellular fixation
steps.instruction: Resuspend wells in 100 µl 2 % paraformaldehyde, incubate 10 min at room temperature, add 100 µl PBS/5 % HIFCS, then spin at 300 g for 3 min at 23 °C.

steps.title: Wash after fixation
steps.instruction: Flick off the supernatant, wash cells with 200 µl PBS/5 % HIFCS, and centrifuge at 300 g for 3 min at 23 °C.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate cells on ice for 30 min with either (i) 25 µl per well of 10E4 anti‑HS monoclonal antibody or mouse IgM (isotype control) diluted to 20 µg ml⁻¹ in PBS/5 % HIFCS/0.3 % saponin, or (ii) 25 µl per well of anti‑Col18 antibody or mouse IgG2b (isotype control) diluted to 4 µg ml⁻¹ in the same buffer; protect from light.

steps.title: Wash after primary
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with PBS/5 % HIFCS/0.03 % saponin (as in Step 9).

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate on ice for 30 min with 25 µl per well of goat anti‑mouse Ig PE diluted to 5 µg ml⁻¹ in PBS/5 % HIFCS/0.3 % saponin; protect from light.

steps.title: Wash after secondary
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with PBS/5 % FCS/0.03 % saponin (as in Step 9).

steps.title: Prepare for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 100 µl per well of PBS/5 % HIFCS, transfer each well to an individual cluster tube, and acquire data on a flow cytometer using R‑PE excitation/emission 565 nm/575 nm.

steps.title: Cell surface staining alternative
steps.instruction: For surface staining, repeat steps 8, 9, 12–15 using PBS/5 % FCS for all washes and antibody dilutions.

steps.title: Data analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze cell‑surface or intracellular HS or Col18 staining with CellQuest™ Pro software version 6.0 (BD Biosciences).

steps.title: Beta‑cell identification
steps.instruction: To determine the percentage of beta cells, perform steps 8 and 9, then resuspend wells in 100 µl of 10 µM Newport Green, incubate 1 h at 37 °C, add 100 µl PBS, centrifuge at 300 g, discard supernatant, resuspend in 100 µl PBS, run flow cytometry, and analyze with CellQuest™ Pro v6.0 to quantify Newport Green‑positive beta cells.
